title: Service Worker Cache
definition: Service Workers provide programmable caching via the Cache API. They act as a network proxy sitting between the browser and the internet, allowing you to intercept network requests and serve cached responses even when offline.
simpleExplanation: A mini-server running inside your browser. If your internet cuts out, it intercepts the request and serves up a saved version of the website.
